text.title: Cut delivery cost per order for Moscow buyers, FreshDrop
text.s: Replace the paper receipt with an SMS link; swap cold packs for insulated bags
text.c: Combine pickups from two dark stores into one courier batch
text.a: Adapt the parcel-locker idea: pickup points at metro exits
text.m: Modify the courier route: loops of 4 stops at most
text.p: Use dark-store couriers for evening restaurant pickups
text.e: Drop the call-before-delivery step: 14% of orders wait for it
text.r: Let the courier choose the drop order, not the dispatcher
text.shortlist: Two ideas passed: batch pickups (Combine) and route rebuild (Modify). Criterion: saves 10+ minutes per trip
text.decision: Test batch pickups in 2 districts from 1 July; check idle time per courier after 4 weeks
